data_mode.default: demo (localStorage demo store 'aio_debug_store', version 25). IFTA data persists ONLY in the demo store regardless of data mode.
data_mode.note: VITE_AIO_DATA_MODE defaults to 'demo' (env.ts:24; .env.example:9). effectiveDataMode() returns 'supabase' only when explicitly set and configured. Production builds REJECT demo data/auth/storage modes (environmentModel.ts:53-62), but every IFTA reducer writes through updateDemoStore (iftaActions.ts:650-661 -> demoStore.ts:963) with no Supabase path, and no Supabase migration has any IFTA table. In a production (supabase) deployment IFTA data would therefore live only in each browser's localStorage: not shared between client and staff, not durable. Supabase repositories exist only for intake/roadmap/service requests/freight/shipper/pretrip (supabaseRepositories.ts:22,77,171,240). Vault storage mode is resolved separately from VITE_AIO_DATA_MODE==='backend' (vaultStorage.ts:7-9) even though env.ts maps 'backend'->'supabase' and has its own VITE_AIO_STORAGE_MODE (env.ts:22,33), so vault file storage stays in demo/data-URL mode under 'supabase'. The IFTA seed is injected on fresh seed (demoSeed.ts:413) and into existing v25 stores via ensureIftaSeed (demoStore.ts:72); v24->v25 upgrade path returns before ensureIftaSeed (demoStore.ts:79-83), so it is seeded on the next load.

rule: FORENSIC, READ-ONLY. DO NOT CHANGE THEM. Visual status and data status are separate (see readiness).

global_findings.finding: IFTA persists only in the localStorage demo store. No Supabase IFTA table exists in the 18 migrations, and production builds reject demo mode — in production, IFTA data would not be shared between client and staff.
IFTA reducers check state only — no actor, permission or organisation check (findQuarter by id). Office guards pass everything in demo mode.
/portal/services/ifta is caught by services/:serviceRequestId (“Service not found”); /office/permitting/fuel-tax(/:caseId) helpers are unrouted; notification links dead-end.
ifta-filing PREPARING (catalog) vs fuel-tax INTERNAL_ONLY (launch) vs GO (public CTA fallback); Road Ready / journey link to a non-existent ifta-setup slug.
No OCR, CSV or ELD-report parsing: receipt and mileage “parsers” are seeded stand-ins; ELD / GPS integration is a vehicle-position interface only.
No tax rates or tax computation anywhere (by design); the staff worksheet that feeds net tax has no writer and is deleted when the next quarter opens.

The generic client activity page and command-center preview show org-scoped events of any visibility (e.g. “Internal note added”). Pre-existing; the IFTA room must read IFTA kinds with visibility customer only.
Three Supabase views lack security_invoker and anon has select grants — fix before any public IFTA surface relies on Supabase.
No product analytics pipeline (classified DEFERRED); interaction analytics events are proposed keys carried by activity + audit.

Settle availability truth (catalog / launch matrix / public CTA / ifta-setup slug) before the public page ships (decision D-IFTA-AVAILABILITY).
Add the staff worksheet writer before RETURN DRAFT can work on a non-seeded quarter (data sprint).
Read client activity as IFTA kinds with visibility customer (do not reuse the generic timeline filter).
Production persistence (Supabase tables + RLS + org-scoped authorisation) is a separate data sprint; UI implementation can proceed against the demo-store contract.

upload_pipeline.note: Reusable: file inputs (VaultUpload, SecureDocumentUploader), validateUploadFile + FILE_POLICY (pdf/jpg/jpeg/png/webp, 15 MB), SHA-256 hashing + findDuplicateDocuments, storeVaultFile (demo: data URL in localStorage; backend: returns 'Secure storage not configured'), OCR placeholders only (metadataExtractionStatus/suggestedMetadata on VaultDocument), archive-migration batch upload. Not present: OCR/receipt parsing (IFTA parseReceipt is seeded-random), camera capture (no capture attribute / getUserMedia), CSV/XLSX parsing (no papaparse/xlsx/tesseract in dependencies; package.json deps are supabase-js, i18next, react, react-dom, react-i18next, react-router-dom), Supabase storage buckets. IFTA captureReceipts/addMileage accept only file names.

eld_gps.note: Only scaffolding: ELD_TELEMATICS provider category and a 'prov-telematics' catalog entry (CUSTOMER_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED), a TelematicsAdapter interface with getVehiclePosition only (no mileage-by-jurisdiction), a demo consent record for client-a, and no adapter implementation in src/integrations/adapters/. IFTA explicitly refuses ELD_GPS_IMPORT ('ELD / GPS connection is not live yet'). ELD Services is COMING_SOON. Seed file labels like 'Motive-IFTA-Truck01.csv' / 'Samsara-RL-11.csv' are strings only.

tax_computation.note: Confirmed by grep (rate, taxRate, iftaRate, tax_rate, surcharge, liabilit, netTax, per gallon): there is no tax-rate table, surcharge, taxable-gallons or liability computation anywhere in src or migrations. 'surcharge' hits are freight fuel surcharge (brokerage/freight); 'liability' hits are insurance. netTax per jurisdiction exists only as staff-worksheet numbers hard-coded in the seed (e.g. PIONEER worksheet iftaSeed.ts:215) and copied into the return summary; a test asserts it is 'staff worksheet, not computed'. No mutation lets staff enter the worksheet, so outside seeded quarters no tax figures can exist.

Tax figures: will AIO ever compute tax (needs quarterly rate tables per jurisdiction and fuel type, surcharges, taxable gallons) or stay staff-worksheet-only? Either way a worksheet-entry mutation/UI is required; none exists.

Route plan: register static /portal/services/ifta (+ tab sub-routes such as /portal/services/ifta/:tab) before the services/:serviceRequestId param route, or move IFTA elsewhere? Use path segments or ?quarter=YYYY-Qn for quarter selection?
